CONTENTS

 

This Report of Foreign Private Issuer on Form 6-K (this “Form 6-K”) consists of Jeffs’ Brands Ltd’s (the “Company”): (i) Unaudited Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements as of, and for the six months ended, June 30, 2025, which are attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1; and (ii) Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations for the six months ended June 30, 2025, which is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.2.

 

This Form 6-K is incorporated by reference into the Company’s Registration Statements on Form F-3 (File No. 333-277188, File No. 333-262835, File No. 333-283848, File No. 333-283904, File No. 333-285030 and File No. 333-287341) and Registration Statements on Form S-8 (File No. 333-269119 and File No. 333-280459) to be a part thereof from the date on which this Form 6-K is submitted, to the extent not superseded by documents or reports subsequently filed or furnished.
